div.div: لُصُوصِيَّةٌ (S, M, K [in the CK without tesh-deed]) and لَصُوصِيَّةٌ, (Ks, S, M, and in a copy of the K,) the latter of which is the more chaste, though the other is the regular form, (TA,) and ↓ لُصُوصَةٌ , (M, A, and so in the CK in the place of the form next preceding,) or ↓ لَصُوصَةٌ , (as in some copies of the K and in the TA) or ↓ لُصُوصٌ and ↓ لَصُوصٌ , (as in a copy of the Msb,) and ↓ لَصَاصٌ and ↓ لَصَصٌ , (K,) Thieving; or thievishness. (S, M, A, Msb, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
